# Browser libraries

Pinned, self-hosted copies of the versions already used by the application:

- Three.js r128: https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r128/three.min.js
  Project: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r128 — MIT license.
- GSAP 3.12.5: https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/gsap/3.12.5/gsap.min.js
- ScrollTrigger 3.12.5: https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/gsap/3.12.5/ScrollTrigger.min.js
  Project and license: https://gsap.com/standard-license/

Original library license headers are retained. These files are not application
code; change the pinned version deliberately when upgrading.
